Wells Fargo & Co (WFC) Stock Declined While Firefly Value Partners LP Has Boosted Stake by $721,188; Middleton & Co Position In Qualcomm (QCOM) Was Lifted
June 15, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Ryan Heslop increased its stake in Wells Fargo & Co (WFC) by 1.27% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Firefly Value Partners Lp bought 13,869 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.45% with the market. The hedge fund run by Ryan Heslop held 1.11M shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $57.99M, up from 1.09 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Firefly Value Partners Lp who had been investing in Wells Fargo & Co for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $266.74 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.76% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $54.74. About 18.19M shares traded. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has risen 4.02% since June 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.55% the S&P500.
